name: Spatial-Orthogonal Cholesky Parameterization
definition: A hybrid parameterization for N-dimensional covariance matrices that combines Cholesky factorization for general structure with skew-symmetric matrices for 3D spatial rotation, ensuring positive semi-definiteness, spatial interpretability, and cross-dimensional correlations.
summary: Spatial-Orthogonal Cholesky Parameterization combines Cholesky factorization with skew-symmetric rotation to parameterize N-dimensional Gaussian splats, preserving 3D spatial interpretability while generalizing beyond three dimensions.
